title: Mixed Duo #032 · 남얼굴 토운드 밤쉘·플럼 스모키 / 남 머슬 모델·글래스 스킨
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the long reflecting pool path in front of the Taj Mahal with pale marble paving, a waist-high ornamental rail and low steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Jamaican person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, an elegant handsome young male face with a high nose bridge, a defined jaw, straight brows and a strong neck, a very faint trace of stubble, deep plum smoky eyes with dark lashes, smooth deep caramel-brown skin, a gentle soft smile, deep dark brown hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying one heavy rough hammered matte metal weight on gold chain (a gold hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a tin pyramid-shaped lump, an iron round bell, a silver hammer head, a tin chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a gold barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten gold bracelets. Extremely long coffin nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous but athletic woman, far beyond any real person; a flat, firmly defined stomach with faint abdominal muscle lines, a very narrow waist, strong rounded shoulders and toned arms, powerful toned thighs and a high firm rounded rear, yet a colossal full bust and wide round hips that keep the dramatic hourglass shape; hard fit muscle under glowing skin, not bulky, not thin, not boyish; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic (a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls), wide carved cream bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense leaf scrolls filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme red platform stiletto slingbacks, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Hawaiian man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, glass-skin makeup with a faint shimmer on the cheekbones, smooth warm bronze skin, a cool composed look, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large silver hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a silver round bell, a copper teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked gold anklets. Extremely long oval nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions), wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense floral medallion border filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme white platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
